blocks.text: CALASIAO, Pangasinan — La Union’s shores are set for a weeklong celebration of music, culture, and seaside adventures during the La Union Surfing Break 2026 (LUSB). The municipalities of Agoo, Bacnotan, and San Juan will host a series of activities from Oct. 25 to Nov. 1, offering visitors opportunities to explore the province’s coastal attractions and experience the local culture and warmth of the community. San Juan will host the local surfing competition, Pawe-can Race, Glow Run, music festival, and surf art installation. The festivities will culminate in the LUSB Finale Concert.
